item.title: MiBeeSteward v0.9.0: Phones Come and Go — the Asset Archive Remembers
item.description: The most numerous devices on a network aren’t servers — they’re phones, and the most transient ones too: on the office WiFi at nine in the morning, gone by six, absent all weekend. A phone upgrade leaves the old handset behind, never to connect again; a guest’s phone visited once, and never again. The old handling was blunt: offline past a threshold, the sweeper deleted the row, history included — and when the same phone ever connected again, it was a “new device”, with nothing to connect it to the last seen time, the old IP, the services it once ran.
